title: Chapter 1143
text:
An hour later …

In the dim room, the green candle flame on the table was the only source of light. The flame flickered and flickered as it was blown by the airflow, illuminating the faces around the table in a pale green color, leaving mottled shadows. It looked very eerie and terrifying.

Above the candle flame, a public interface floated, showing the introduction of the Black Star Character Summon Card.

The captain of Team Gold, whose ID was' Flying Free ', was a veteran player who had entered the game in Version 1.0. At this moment, he had a worried expression on his face as he spoke in a low voice.

"I didn't expect to discover such a huge secret. Everyone, what should we do now?"

"What else can we do? Quickly announce it!"

"But this is our trump card for the finals. If we announce it, won't we be exposed …"

"Aiya, look at the situation now. Why do you still care so much? Compared to the safety of the entire army, the victory of the competition is no longer important. Don't you know what's more important? "

While everyone was arguing, a female player suddenly raised her hand weakly and asked, "I have a question.

Why don't we turn on the lights and only light candles? "

"We need such a dark environment to talk about such an important matter. That's how it is in movies."

"I understand the logic, but why do we only light candles?" Another team member scratched his head.

"We might be the only ones who have discovered the truth. The atmosphere has to be serious. Do you understand the sense of ceremony?"

Another team member said, "I see. But why do we only light candles?"

"Enough!"

Flying Free could not take it anymore. He got up and went to turn on the lights, pulling the topic back.

After obtaining the Black Star Character Summon Card, the hearts of the members of Team Gold were shaken. They quickly returned to the stronghold to discuss what to do.

In terms of how to deal with this problem, the entire team was divided into two factions. One side felt that they should keep the secret until after the finals. The other side felt that this matter was of great importance and should be announced on the forums immediately, reminding all the army players that their faction leader had been swapped.

Although it was not easy for them to enter the Blackstar Cup finals, after discovering this secret, the competition immediately lost its interest. Everyone's attention was completely attracted by the mystery of the Army Commander's identity.

The character summon card was marked with the prefix "Black Star", but no one dared to guarantee that this wasn't the target's disguise. After all, there had been similar cases before. A blank character summon card's name would usually only show the target's current identity, which meant that it wouldn't be able to see through the disguise.

For example, if a blank Character Summon Card was used on Sorokin or Oathkeeper, it would only display "Sorokin Character Summon Card" or "Oathkeeper Character Summon Card". It would not reveal their true identities.

Therefore, in everyone's eyes, this ability with the suffix "Manison" was obviously more convincing!

Boom!

Flying Free slammed the table and said firmly, "I think that we should immediately announce this news. We have no chance of reaching the finals in the official league, but the Blackstar Cup gives us a chance. Even if we lose the finals, we'll still be in the top four and gain a lot of popularity. If not for the Blackstar Cup organized by the army, all of this would not have existed. As the old saying goes, don't forget the person who dug the well when you reap the benefits. The competition rewards are only a small benefit, but protecting the entire army is the biggest benefit!

Furthermore, over the past few versions, how many benefits has the Army Commander brought to us? How many people like this character? He might be in danger now, so how can we sit back and do nothing? Now, the opportunity to save the army is in our hands! "

Many of the solo players present were hardcore Chinese players. They had deep feelings for the army and had long treated it as their own faction.

For a hardcore like Flying Free, in order to protect the army and Black Star, he was even willing to give up the benefits of the finals just to remind everyone. Because the number of people he had was not enough, it was better to gather the strength of the army players and think of a way to destroy the Mecha Empire's' scheme 'together!

Hearing this, everyone thought of the past and suddenly felt their blood boil. A belief rose in their hearts.

At this time, Flying Free stretched out his hand. Everyone understood and put their hands together. They looked at each other and saw a strong sense of responsibility in each other's eyes.

"Now, it's our turn to save the Army Commander!"

After shouting this slogan, Flying Free immediately opened the forums and started writing a post. Without hesitation, he wrote a title …

"Secrets of the Century! The Unspeakable Secret of Black Star and the Mecha Empire! "

…

The fleet rested on Planet Black Gate for half a day before setting off again, heading toward the final venue of the Blackstar Cup.

In the cabin, Han Xiao and Sylvia talked about work for half a day before waving for Sylvia to leave.

He was the only one left in the room. He leaned back comfortably on the chair, opened the forum, and began his daily observation of the idiotic netizens.

"Let me see what's the Happy Meal today …"

Han Xiao hummed a tune as he entered the forums. With one look, he was instantly dumbfounded.

At a glance, all of them were "Urgent Requests for Dissemination!" The Army Commander's Identity Is a Mystery! " "The Mecha Empire's Shocking Conspiracy!" "Emergency! The Black Star Corps Might Change Hands! " "Save the Army Commander!" The entire Flickering World was flooded with similar posts.

What the hell is all this?

I haven't looked at the forums for half a day. What happened?

Han Xiao was confused. He opened the most popular post and saw that the person who posted it was an ID that he recognized. It was the captain of the Gold Team, Flying Free.

At the beginning of the post was a high-definition screenshot. It was the introduction of the Black Star Character Summon Card. Seeing the name of the ability of [Billion Mecha Empire – Manison], Han Xiao immediately understood what was going on. His mouth could not help but twitch.

"It can't be. I have thousands of abilities, and this just had to be drawn by a blank Character Summon Card? What kind of luck did these people have? Speaking of which, I just came back. When was this drawn? Could it be that I was touched at the dock? "

He continued reading, and as expected, Flying Free explained what had happened.

"Hello, everyone. I'm Flying Free from the Gold Team. Just an hour ago, we discovered a shocking secret!

Not long ago, when the Army Commander returned to the territory, our team blended in with the crowd and planned to use a blank Character Summon Card to record Black Star's ability. Originally, we wanted to use it as our trump card in the upcoming Blackstar Cup finals. However, as you can see in the screenshot, we did not expect to draw the ability of the Mecha Empire from Black Star! This shocked all of us!

We couldn't understand this situation. After some discussion, we came to a shocking conclusion. The current Army Commander might be the Mecha Empire in disguise! His goal is to replace Black Star and usurp the throne of our Army Commander!

In the end, we unanimously decided to immediately publicize such crucial information. We need everyone to unite to find out the truth and unravel the conspiracy! Everyone, the future of the Army Commander is in our hands! "

Han Xiao had a constipated expression on his face.

This deduction did not seem unreasonable, but why did he still feel that there was something wrong with these people's brains?

He looked at the replies below. It had already exploded, and countless people were doubting him.

"Is this for real? This picture can't be photoshopped, right?"

"It must be photoshopped. These young people want to create big news every day."

"Are you guys thinking that there's no hope of winning, so you want to do something stupid?"

"Good job, I'll reward you with a piece of earwax."

"It's over. Someone is going to change their name to the Mecha Empire."

Facing the doubts, Flying Free added in the popular replies:

"I know everyone must have their doubts. On the day of the finals, we will use this Character Summon Card and show it to everyone to make them believe that the Army Commander needs us to save them!"

Save your grandma's leg!

Han Xiao gritted his teeth and returned to the page. He quickly browsed through the related posts and found that other than the doubters, there were many posts seriously analyzing this possibility:

[Reinhardt: Maybe it's true. The Mecha Empire definitely has the motive to do this. Didn't they have a conflict in the Ancient Star Desert some time ago? Could it be that the Mecha Empire attacked the Army Commander after that?]

[Pikachu: If this is fake, then where is the real Army Commander? Was he killed?]

[Wolf Fire: Probably not. After all, the Army Commander is so tanky. I think the Mecha Empire just exiled him and won't be able to return for a while. That's why he dared to pretend to be Black Star!]

[Foot Scratching Hippo: Do you all agree that the Army Commander has been swapped? Could it be that Black Star used some method to learn the Mecha Empire's ability?]

[Smelly Foot Buster: The possibility is too low. After so many years, this is the first time a blank character card has drawn a unique ability from Black Star.]

[Zero to the Zero: Could it be that they made a deal to teach each other their unique abilities?]

[My Dog Is Called Lagi: Hmm, so … if we use a blank character card on the Mecha Empire now, it's possible to draw "Indestructible Body: Black Star"?]

[Good Brother Pats Big: Damn, that's awesome!]

You're a f * cking genius … Han Xiao felt his teeth ache.

[Ice Tornado: Wait, there are other possibilities! Could it be that Black Star's ability was taught by the Mecha Empire from the start?!]

[Blueberry: That's shocking! That makes sense. If Black Star was a secret disciple of the Mecha Empire from a long time ago, his rapid rise can be explained!]

[Shadow Stream Execution Song: From the looks of it, the falling out some time ago was just a two-man show. One jumped the other, the other pretended to be loyal, but they were in cahoots behind the scenes. That's too showy. Tsk … I understand now! The Mecha Empire has a big conspiracy. They're playing a big game of chess!]

What do you understand?!

Veins popped out on Han Xiao's forehead.

[Sanguine Rose: I can't take it anymore. I can't hold back my curiosity. What happened between Black Star and the Mecha Empire?]

[Paradise Disco: Let me remind you, if I ask the Legion Commander directly, will I be killed? Although I'm not afraid …]

[Pork Bun Beats Dog: Ah, my eyes see through everything. A storm is brewing. This secret may lead to a new main storyline … I have a feeling that the theme of the next version will be the division of the Black Star Corps! I have material again!]

You're the one who's divided. Your whole family is divided!

Han Xiao felt that if he grabbed these players and shook them, he would definitely be able to hear the sound of liquid sloshing around in their heads.

He glanced through and suddenly saw a new post. The title was' Army Rescue Plan: Call to Action '.

He clicked on it and saw that it was another post by that freelance shit-thrower.

"Brothers and sisters, the Black Star Corps has accompanied us for four versions. This is our faction. We can't let anyone take away the fruits of our hard work!

Unfortunately, the officers of the army won't believe us. Only the players can see our evidence.

For this reason, I've decided to start a righteous rebellion. While the Blackstar Cup Commendation Ceremony is being broadcasted live to the entire universe, I'm going to stand out and expose the true face of the Mecha Empire!

Therefore, I need everyone's strength!

Although we're far from being a match for a Beyond Grade A, we can use our lives to let the entire universe see the scheme of the Mecha Empire!

All those who are willing to participate, leave your name in this post and contact us.

Everyone, draw your swords. It's up to us to save the army now!

Although I'm dead, I'm still a pawn under the Black Star!

Manison of the Mecha Empire, show your health bar! "

Han Xiao was dumbfounded.

Scrolling down, the number of replies to this post was increasing at a rate of a hundred per second. Countless people were extremely excited and clamored to sign up. Who knew how many of them were people who wanted to see the world burn?

What the f * ck, are they trying to stab me in the back?

Han Xiao's expression was extremely complicated.

He did not know if he should be hurt or touched.

After this incident, it could be seen that the results of my four versions were very obvious. I've already formed a deep bond with the Chinese players. These players are willing to go to such lengths for me. It's really touching … touching my ass!

There's such a thing?

After reading the post twice, Han Xiao clenched his teeth.

"You don't say, this post made my blood boil … Damn it, a mental patient really has a lot of fun!"
